creator: <module>
resources.closer: with _COLLECTION_LOCK exits release each acquisition; singleton remains process-scoped
resources.shutdown_contract: The collector serializes cache resets and reads under the reentrant lock. Normal and Python-exception exits release the acquisition through the with statement. There is no lock acquisition timeout or explicit lock destruction; interruption/native worker behavior still requires #12553 observation.

cancellation.applicability: synchronous primitive; cancellation belongs to an outer caller

There is no lock acquisition timeout or explicit lock destruction; interruption/native worker behavior still requires #12553 observation.
cancellation.observation: Interrupt an owning caller and observe physical file/scanner/lock completion; a cancelled future is insufficient.

timeout.applicability: no intrinsic filesystem/lock deadline in these helpers
timeout.expected: Do not infer a bounded native operation or released lock from an outer timeout. The collector serializes cache resets and reads under the reentrant lock. Normal and Python-exception exits release the acquisition through the with statement. There is no lock acquisition timeout or explicit lock destruction; interruption/native worker behavior still requires #12553 observation.
timeout.observation: Record the outer deadline and actual close/release completion independently.

retry.applicability: next collector call; no internal retry in these primitives
retry.expected: A new collector call resets text caches under the same retained lock. File/scanner allocations are per operation; this implies no transactional/idempotency guarantee.
retry.observation: Compare per-attempt handles and the process-scoped lock identity before/after retry.
